opening.argument: The video presents a step-by-step instructional walkthrough of Coinbase and Base self-custody, beginning with how to “download and set up this Coinbase wallet step-by-step.” Its recovery-phrase guidance is protective: viewers are told to “save these 12 words in a secure location such as a password manager and never share them with anyone,” while the backup screen shows a blurred phrase area and manual or iCloud backup controls. The material demonstrates ordinary wallet use, including purchasing $50 of Ethereum and swapping $20 into Aero on Base, with assets visibly listed afterward. Although it mentions a free Bitcoin bonus and affiliate links, there is no evidence of deceptive behavior, guaranteed returns, an unsafe destination, disclosure to another party, resulting asset movement from phrase handling, or any connection between the referral material and that handling.
